properties.description: Built 2026-10-28 (branch reading/prediction-order). crates/reflow2-core/src/prediction_order.rs, read by reasoning_report as `prediction_order`: for each walked step with a result premise (statement_kind evidence) beside Requirement premises (bears supports), and each CONTRADICTS from a result to a walked node (bears contests), the prediction's server stamps against the result's: stated_before_the_result (its wording was recorded before the result), stated_after_the_result (post hoc), revised_after_the_result (first stated before, content changed after; earlier_wording_in names the Snapshot this server recorded at or after the result, which keeps the wording it had), changed_after_the_result (creation not recorded here), order_not_recorded (written before stamping), imported_not_recorded_here (a stamp this store cannot vouch for). Each with a sentence and the times. Read only from the stamps, never reported_at, acted_at or any typed date. Said, never enforced: nothing refused, no support, contest or refutation reading moves. Absent when no result tests anything the walk reached, so a design with no results reads as before. The design-a-phenomenon skill teaches it and drops its honest limit "nothing checks that a prediction was written before the result".
properties.name: A prediction reads whether it was stated before the result that tests it, from the server's stamps, said and never enforced
